projects.title: Popeye Beach Restaurant & Aurora Villa - Tourism Platform Optimization
projects.description: Boosting Popeye Beach Restaurant & Aurora Villa Across Airbnb, Booking.com & More
projects.details:
Sri Lanka's south coast tourism thrives in hotspots like Ahangama, but many oceanfront restaurants and villas struggle behind the scenes. Incomplete listings, platform restrictions, and blocked verifications often keep great properties hidden from surfers, travelers, and food lovers.

Magic Hat Digital stepped in to fix these issues, providing professional solutions that optimized Popeye Beach Restaurant and Aurora Villa for maximum visibility and bookings.

The Challenge: Ahangama Gems Hidden from View
Rohan manages Popeye Beach Restaurant, an oceanfront dining and bar experience with panoramic surf views, alongside Aurora Villa & Hostel, just steps from Ahangama Beach and Mash Mellow Surf Point.

Despite the prime location, digital hurdles limited success:
• Airbnb listings live but not generating bookings
• Hostelworld profiles never went live
• Google Business verification blocked, hiding the restaurant from map searches
• Booking.com account incomplete, limiting exposure

The result? Empty tables and low occupancy, even during peak surf season near Kabalana Beach.

Our Solution: Integrated Tourism & Platform Overhaul
Magic Hat Digital delivered a full solution to fix technical issues and unlock online visibility:

Platform Setup & Fixes:
• Verified and optimized Airbnb and Booking.com accounts with professional photos, titles like 'Aurora Villa and Hostel Ahangama', and detailed descriptions highlighting WiFi and garden terraces.
• Troubleshot and attempted Google Business verification to ensure restaurant presence on maps.
• Prepared Hostelworld listings for launch with surf-optimized keywords.

Performance Boosts:
• Introduced dynamic pricing for peak surf seasons
• Implemented automated guest messaging and cross-promotions
• Aligned villa and restaurant digital profiles for seamless customer experience

All updates were executed efficiently, preparing properties to capture Ahangama's beach crowd.

The Results: Bookings, Reviews & Growth
Even with some platforms still pending, improvements were immediate on Airbnb and Booking.com:
• Airbnb visibility increased – live listings now attracting traffic
• Platform readiness – Hostelworld and Google setup prepared for launch
• Improved property presentation – Reels, photos, compelling descriptions, and dynamic pricing in place

Magic Hat Digital now manages the technical and platform aspects, letting Rohan focus on hospitality and guest experience.

projects.title: Ketha Solutions - Logo Design & Digital Strategy
projects.description: Logo Design & Digital Strategy Launch for futuristic software company
projects.details:
Crafted a unique, minimalist logo for Ketha Solutions—a forward-thinking software company delivering futuristic enterprise solutions powered by cutting-edge technologies.

Client Challenge
Ketha needed more than a typical software logo. They wanted simple yet distinctive branding that reflects their innovative approach to future-ready business solutions.

Our Approach
• Logo Creation: Designed a clean, modern logo incorporating subtle tech motifs (circuit-inspired lines, geometric futurism) while maintaining simplicity for versatile use across digital/print.
• Digital Strategy Roadmap: Developed a comprehensive launch plan including website wireframes, social media frameworks, content strategy, and SEO positioning for their niche tech market.

Project Impact
This foundational branding positions Ketha Solutions as a premium futuristic software provider, ready to attract enterprise clients seeking next-gen solutions. Logo delivered first, strategy rollout in progress.

projects.title: Ceylon Pharma Academy - Social Media Growth Campaign
projects.description: Scaled from 6 students to 25-30 per batch through targeted Facebook boosting
projects.details:
Scaled Ceylon Pharma Academy—an affordable online pharmacy course provider—from 6 students to consistent 25-30 per batch, every two months, through targeted Facebook boosting.

Client Challenge
Started with just 6 enrolled students. Organic Facebook reach was minimal despite competitive pricing for pharmacy practice courses.

Our Strategy
• Facebook Ad Boosting: Low-budget campaigns targeting Sri Lankan healthcare aspirants, yielding 50+ registrations in first push and steady 25-30 students per bi-monthly batch.
• Organic Growth Tips: Content optimization, posting schedules, and engagement strategies for sustainable reach.
• Consultation Support: Course positioning, student retention, and enrollment scaling advice.

Results Achieved
• Batch Consistency: Now fills 25-30 students every 2 months (+400% sustained growth).
• Ongoing Management: Handle all Facebook boosting plus organic/consulting support.

projects.title: Surfing Pinthaliya - Logo & Branding
projects.description: Complete branding for surf hotel including logo, staff uniforms and t-shirts
projects.details:
Created a unique logo and comprehensive branding for Surfing Pinthaliya—a cozy small hotel just 100m from Midigama Beach in Weligama, perfect for surfers.

Client Challenge
Needed distinctive visual identity beyond generic beach hotel looks. Branding extended to staff uniforms and t-shirts for cohesive surf-vibe presentation.

Our Solution
• Custom Logo Design: Simple, wave-inspired logo capturing Midigama's surf culture with clean lines for digital/print versatility.
• Branding Package: Designed staff t-shirts and uniforms featuring the logo, surf motifs, and beach-ready colors.
• Brand Consistency: Ensured all elements reflect the relaxed, authentic Weligama surf stay experience.

Project Impact
Surfing Pinthaliya now stands out among Midigama competitors with professional, surf-centric branding that attracts the right guests—digital-ready for Airbnb/Booking.com listings.
